description: R300 AI Motor cross-profile link contract. Single source of truth for the STM32<->Jetson UART frame, the STM32<->ATmega128A supervised heartbeat, the safety state machine and the pin map. Every consumer file is generated; editing a consumer by hand is a defect even when the value still matches.

acquisition.note: 128 samples at 1000 S/s = 128 ms per frame. A 512-sample window with hop 256 gives a 3.90625 Hz inference refresh and 1.953125 Hz FFT bin spacing.

diagnosticUart.note: Read-only safety diagnostics; never relay authority

crc.name: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE
crc.decision: The ICD left polynomial, init, reflection and xorout open. CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE is fixed here because it is table-free on ATmega128A, unambiguous, and has a published check value.

telemetryStatusRules: AVR state and cause bits require AVR_DIAG_VALID.
AVR_ARMED and AVR_TRIPPED are mutually exclusive.
AVR_ESTOP and AVR_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT are mutually exclusive and require AVR_TRIPPED.

timing.name: HEARTBEAT_TOGGLE_MS
timing.purpose: PB8 toggle period while the Jetson link and local acquisition are both healthy

timing.name: HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS
timing.purpose: the AVR trips the relay when no heartbeat edge arrives within this window

timing.name: JETSON_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT_MS
timing.purpose: one missed 100 ms HEALTH plus 80 ms jitter stops PB8; combined with the 500 ms AVR timeout this leaves 20 ms of the 700 ms target for relay response

timing.name: JETSON_LINK_HEALTHY_MAX_AGE_MS
timing.purpose: one 128 ms TELEMETRY period may elapse before HEALTH clears LINK_HEALTHY

timing.name: INFERENCE_WORKER_STALL_MS
timing.purpose: clear LINK_HEALTHY when one inference or presentation callback exceeds the application-liveness deadline

timing.name: INFERENCE_P95_TARGET_MS
timing.purpose: target p95 model callback latency on the deployed Jetson

timing.name: PACKET_TO_UI_P95_TARGET_MS

timing.name: CONDITION_WARNING_TARGET_MS
timing.purpose: target from a persistent abnormal condition to advisory WARNING

timing.name: UI_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS
timing.purpose: clear LINK_HEALTHY when a bound Qt main loop misses three 100 ms refresh heartbeats

timing.name: AVR_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_MS
timing.purpose: reset a stalled safety main loop early enough to preserve the 700 ms relay-off target

timing.name: AVR_RESET_TO_SAFE_MS

timing.name: SUPERVISION_FAILURE_TO_RELAY_TARGET_MS

timing.name: FRAME_PERIOD_MS

timing.name: INPUT_DEBOUNCE_MS

motorDirections.name: FORWARD
motorDirections.purpose: PB6 PWM with PB7 held low

safetyStates.name: ARMED
safetyStates.purpose: manual ARM asserted AND heartbeat healthy AND E-stop inactive AND no internal fault

signals.name: HEARTBEAT
signals.note: Supervised. AVR PE4 internal pull-up prevents a floating input while STM32 PB8 is high-impedance at reset. Toggled only while the Jetson keepalive and local acquisition health are both valid. An unconditional timer toggle would not detect Jetson failure and is forbidden.

signals.name: ESTOP
signals.logicLevel: 5V with internal pull-up, switch to GND
signals.note: Prototype input. Real machinery requires a certified E-stop and safety relay.

signals.name: ARM
signals.logicLevel: 5V with internal pull-up, switch to GND
signals.note: Manual re-arm only. Never asserted by software.

signals.name: RELAY
signals.note: R2 bias must hold the relay de-energized while PD7 is tri-stated during reset. Trigger polarity must be measured before motor power is applied.

AF4 open-drain; keep the cable short

1kHz active-high; selected LR7843 module accepts 3.3V input
held LOW; LR7843 is a one-direction low-side switch, not an H-bridge
diagnostics only; never a safety command
LEVEL SHIFT OR DIVIDER REQUIRED; a 5V output drives a 3.3V pin
reserved by pinmap v4; AI abnormal must never become a direct relay trip output
heartbeat edge capture with internal pull-up reset bias; INT4 to INT7 avoid the USART0 and TWI pins
diagnostic UART transmit; requires level shifting toward the STM32
must leave the relay de-energized while tri-stated at reset; see R2 bias

supersedes.note: The AVR side of this contract intentionally contradicts the cited pinmap and BOM. Those documents specify an ATmega328P/Arduino Nano; the built system uses an ATmega128A, so every AVR pin here is reassigned and this contract is authoritative for them. The STM32 and Jetson pins are unchanged from the cited pinmap.
